verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe Tax offers filing automation via TaxJar integration (stripe-tax-docs-10) and itemized tax exports (stripe-tax-docs-11), but there is no mention of a filing calendar, per-filing status tracker, remitted-amount summaries, or downloadable filing confirmations. A community report even states that despite Stripe's tooling users 'still have to do everything yourself - filing the papers and wiring money' (stripe-tax-comm-4), reinforcing the absence of a consolidated filing dashboard. Missing for 10: filing calendar view, per-filing status indicators, remitted amount tracking, downloadable confirmation documents.
